title: Field & Wall
tagline: One field. One wall. One town.

lines.en: One field. One wall. One town.
Field and Wall. Lay tiles, place meeples, raise walls.
lines.zh: 筑野。铺瓷砖、放木人、修城墙。

lines.en: Match the edges. Turn the tile until the city meets the city.
lines.zh: 边对边，转到城接城、路接路。

lines.en: Claim a city, road or monastery with one wooden meeple.
lines.zh: 放一个木人，占住城市、道路或修道院。

lines.en: Close it, bring the meeples home, and score.
lines.zh: 合拢，木人回家，马上计分。

lines.en: Four AI levels, hot-seat, or a phone joins over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 四档 AI、同屏热座，或手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入。

lines.en: Undo, hints, autosave, and a family record.
lines.zh: 悔棋、提示、自动保存和家庭战绩。

lines.en: Field and Wall. Offline, no account, no ads.
lines.zh: 筑野。离线、无账号、无广告。
